scripts.build: cd client/kala-sangam && npm install && npm run build:production
scripts.build:local: cd client/kala-sangam && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:render: cd client/kala-sangam && npm ci && npm run build:production && cd ../.. && mkdir -p dist && cp -r client/kala-sangam/dist/* ./ && cd server && npm ci
scripts.start: cd server && npm install && npm start
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client/kala-sangam && npm install && cd ../../server && npm install
scripts.build-and-start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.deploy:render: git add . && git commit -m 'Deploy to Render' && git push origin main
scripts.test:build: npm run build && cd client/kala-sangam && npm run preview
